d.ko: Wartales is an open world RPG in which you lead a group of mercenaries in their search for wealth across a massive medieval universe. Explore the world, recruit companions, collect bounties and unravel the secrets of the tombs of the ancients!
d.en: Wartales is an open world RPG in which you lead a group of mercenaries in their search for wealth across a massive medieval universe. Explore the world, recruit companions, collect bounties and unravel the secrets of the tombs of the ancients!
d.zh: 《Wartales》是一款开放世界 RPG 游戏，你将带领一群雇佣兵在浩大的中世纪宇宙中进行探索，寻觅财富。探索世界，招募同伴，领取赏金，揭开先民之墓的秘密！
